bugs.summary: read_rows now returns a one-shot generator, but report.summarize (unchanged) iterates it twice: any() consumes rows up to and including the first high-severity row, so the summary loop never sees them. The first high-severity event, and everything before it, is missing from the daily security summary.
bugs.trigger: Log: mallory export-db (high), alice login (low), bob delete-user (high). Before: 2 high events of 3. After: 1 high event of 2; mallory's export-db is gone.

related_valid: The generator keeps the file open until fully consumed or garbage-collected, so a caller that stops early leaves the handle open.
A parse error is now raised mid-iteration (after earlier rows were already processed or exported) instead of before any processing, so export_jsonl can leave a partial output file.
